 This Criminal Petition Is Filed U/S 482 Of Cr.P.C.,
(U/Sec. 528 Of Bnss, 2023) Seeking To Quash The Entire
Proceedings In Cc No.868/2024 (Haveri Rural Ps Crime
No.27/2020) On The File Of The Prl. Civil Judge And
Jmfc, Haveri Registered For The Offences Punishable
U/S 406, 409, 201 And 420 Of Ipc Vide Annexure - A In
Respect Of Petitioners/Accused No.9 And 10.
 This Petition, Coming On For Order

S, THIS DAY,
THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
CORAM: THE HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE N.S.SANJAY GOWDA  ORAL ORDER 1.

In Criminal Petition No.102513 of 2024, which was filed by accused Nos.5, 6 and 7, this Court has quashed the proceedings that has been initiated against those petitioners and also which was initiated against the present petitioners.
2. In fact, that judgment was rendered on the basis of an earlier decision rendered in Criminal Petition No.100515 of 2024 disposed of on 16.02.2024.
3. Since the proceedings in respect of other accused have already been quashed, it would be appropriate NC: 2025:KHC-D:473 to quash the proceedings insofar as the petitioners are concerned.
4. In that view of the matter, the impugned proceedings insofar as the petitioners herein are concerned (accused Nos.9 and 10) also stand quashed.

5. The criminal petition is accordingly allowed.
Sd/-
(N.S.SANJAY GOWDA) JUDGE RK Manjunath S/O Channabasappa ... vs The State Of Karnataka on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/172625316/
